questions.question: In Witness, Ford’s cop hides in which American religious community?
questions.note: Lancaster County, Pennsylvania. A boy named Samuel sees a murder in a Philadelphia station bathroom.

questions.question: Who directed Witness (1985)?
questions.note: The Australian director of Picnic at Hanging Rock and Dead Poets Society. He later made The Mosquito Coast with Ford.

questions.question: Who plays Rachel Lapp, the Amish widow in Witness?
questions.note: The barn-raising dance is the poster. McGillis was later in Top Gun.

questions.question: For which film was Harrison Ford nominated for a Best Actor Oscar?
questions.note: The 1986 Oscars, for 1985. He has never won a competitive acting Oscar. William Hurt won that year for Kiss of the Spider Woman.

questions.question: In Working Girl, what is Ford’s merger-advisor character named?
questions.note: Melanie Griffith is Tess McGill; Sigourney Weaver is the boss who steals her idea. Mike Nichols directed.

questions.question: Who plays Tess McGill, Ford’s love interest in Working Girl?
questions.note: Griffith got an Oscar nomination. Weaver plays Katharine Parker, the Staten Island-to-Wall-Street obstacle.

questions.question: In Frantic, Ford’s doctor searches Paris after his wife vanishes. Who directed it?
questions.note: 1988. A switched suitcase, the Eiffel Tower, and a very lost American.

questions.question: In The Mosquito Coast, who plays Ford’s on-screen son?
questions.note: Peter Weir again, from Paul Theroux’s novel. Phoenix later played young Indy in The Last Crusade.

questions.question: In Regarding Henry, what happens to Ford’s ruthless lawyer at the start of the film?
questions.answer: He is shot in the head
choices: He is shot in the head
He gets amnesia from a virus
questions.note: A robbery at a convenience store. Annette Bening is his wife. Mike Nichols directed.

questions.question: In Presumed Innocent, Ford’s prosecutor is on trial for murdering whom?
questions.answer: A colleague he had an affair with
choices: A colleague he had an affair with
questions.note: Carolyn Polhemus, played by Greta Scacchi. Alan J. Pakula directed, from Scott Turow’s novel. 1990.
